description.value:
The Burya belongs in a museum as a benchmark for Soviet design. Is it pretty to look at? No. Convenient to use? Nope. Safe? Nuh-uh. But effective? Abso-fucking-lutely. The RT-46 is an electromag pistol that can blast through walls and is practically as dense as a neutron star. On top of that, it doesn't need to be charged – it can be fired at any time. To use it and survive, advanced musculoskeletal cyberware is advised.

Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 5d6, Drop Lowest • Capacity: 4 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon’s Tech Rebuild can be charged without a Move Action. Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. When fired by a user without BODY 10+ or a Cyberarm, they suffer the Broken Arm Critical Injury if they didn’t have it already.

Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 5d6, dropping the lowest die. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
